text: The GLOF-II project aims to mitigate the risks associated with glacial lake outburst floods in Northern Pakistan, particularly in the Gilgit-Baltistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa regions. It builds upon the pilot GLOF-I project by expanding its scope to 12 districts, integrating structural and non-structural measures such as engineering interventions, hydrometeorological monitoring, early warning systems, and community capacity building. The project is funded by the Green Climate Fund and implemented by the UNDP in collaboration with the Government of Pakistan.

metadata.solution_name: Scaling-up of Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) Risk Reduction in Northern Pakistan (GLOF-II)
